ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף הֵכִין מִבְחָן לְאֶחָיו וְהִסְתִּיר גָּבִיעַ בַּשַּׂק שֶׁל בִּנְיָמִין.
ideas.children_en: Joseph gave his brothers food sacks and returned their money. He secretly put his special silver cup in the youngest brother's sack. In the morning, the brothers left on their journey.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים הֻאֲשְׁמוּ בִּגְנֵבָה שֶׁלֹּא יָדְעוּ עָלֶיהָ.
ideas.children_en: After the brothers left the city, Joseph sent his official to accuse them of stealing his special cup, which was important to him.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים הָיוּ בְּטוּחִים שֶׁלֹּא גָּנְבוּ דָּבָר.
ideas.children_en: The brothers were surprised by the accusation and said they did not steal. They agreed that whoever has the cup should become a slave.

ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁנִּמְצָא הַגָּבִיעַ אֵצֶל בִּנְיָמִין, הָאַחִים נִבְהֲלוּ וְהִצְטַעֲרוּ.
ideas.children_en: The brothers opened their sacks and the cup was found with Benjamin. They felt scared and torn their clothes to show grief.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף אָמַר שֶׁרַק בִּנְיָמִין יִשָּׁאֵר אֶצְלוֹ.
ideas.children_en: At Joseph's house, he told them that only the one with the cup would be a slave. The brothers agreed and understood.

ideas.children_he: יְהוּדָה הֵחֵל לְסַפֵּר לְיוֹסֵף עַל הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה וְעַל אָבִיהֶם.
ideas.children_en: Judah spoke sincerely and said Joseph already knew they had a father and a young brother their father loved very much.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים יָדְעוּ שֶׁהַפְּרֵדָה מִבִּנְיָמִין תִּכְאַב מְאֹד לְיַעֲקֹב.
ideas.children_en: Joseph asked to bring Benjamin to notice and protect him. The brothers said their father would not allow it because it would make him sad.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב הִסְכִּים בְּקֹשִׁי לִשְׁלֹחַ אֶת בִּנְיָמִין.
ideas.children_en: The brothers told their father all that happened. Jacob was afraid to take Benjamin on the trip because he might get hurt and Jacob would be very sad.

ideas.children_he: יְהוּדָה הֵבִין שֶׁהַמַּעֲשִׂים שֶׁלּוֹ מַשְׁפִּיעִים גַּם עַל אָבִיו.
ideas.children_en: Judah said it would be very hard for their father if Benjamin didn't come back, because they are very close.

ideas.children_he: יְהוּדָה פָּחַד שֶׁהַצַּעַר יִהְיֶה קָשֶׁה מִדַּי לְיַעֲקֹב.
ideas.children_en: Judah explained that if their father sees Benjamin isn't there, he will die from great sadness.

ideas.children_he: יְהוּדָה הִזְכִּיר אֶת הַהַבְטָחָה שֶׁנָּתַן לְאָבִיו.
ideas.children_en: Judah spoke for the brothers and said he is ready to take responsibility to return Benjamin, so their father won't be hurt.

ideas.children_he: יְהוּדָה הִצִּיעַ לְהִשָּׁאֵר בְּעַצְמוֹ בִּמְקוֹם בִּנְיָמִין. זֹאת אַחֲרָיוּת אֲמִתִּית.
ideas.children_en: Judah offered to stay a slave instead of Benjamin, so Benjamin could go home with his brothers.

ideas.children_he: יְהוּדָה לֹא רָצָה לַחֲזֹר הַבַּיְתָה בְּלִי אָחִיו הַקָּטָן.
ideas.children_en: Judah cannot bear thinking their father will be sad if Benjamin is lost. He loves Benjamin very much and that's why he says this.
